definitions.explanation: A book containing practice problems or exercises for study, typically used for test preparation or skill building.

examples.japanese: {問題集|もんだいしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧。
examples.english: To work through a problem set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{問題集|もんだいしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a workbook for exam preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{問題集|もんだいしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: This workbook has detailed explanations included.

notes:
{問題集|もんだいしゅう} is a book of practice problems used for study and test preparation. The word combines ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (problem/question) and {集|しゅう} (collection).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {問題集|もんだいしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (to work through a problem set)
- {問題集|もんだいしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy a workbook)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{問題集|もんだいしゅう} (workbook for ~, e.g., ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{問題集|もんだいしゅう})

TYPES:
- {過去|かこ}{問題集|もんだいしゅう}/{過去問|かこもん}: past exam question collection
- ⟦{演習|えんしゅう}→演習：13363_enshuu⟧{問題集|もんだいしゅう}: practice exercise book
- ⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧{問題集|もんだいしゅう}: entrance exam workbook

USAGE:
Central to the Japanese study culture of repeated practice (⟦{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}→反復練習：22063_hanpukurenshuu⟧). Students commonly buy {問題集|もんだいしゅう} for specific exams or subjects. Many come with separate ⟦{解答|かいとう}→解答：00447_kaitou⟧⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧ (answer explanations) booklets.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧: reference book (explanations, not just problems)
- ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧: textbook
